note: COMPOSED demo device, not real coupled physics. Splices two real single-fault missions on a continuous renumbered t axis: first 80s from real lubricationdegradation run UNIT-lubricationdegradation-0018_M003 rows 90-169 (oil_pump_health=0.5, declining oil_pressure signature, mid-CLIMB), then 41s from real mechanicalvibration run UNIT-mechanicalvibration-0063_M006 rows 90-130 (bearing_health=0.5, rising vibration_rms_x_bearing_proxy signature, also mid-CLIMB) appended immediately after. Both segments start already in CLIMB (not IDLE) so altitude/state vary from t=0 and the splice doesn't present as a nonsensical engine_state jump -- both donors are in CLIMB at their respective start rows. t is strictly monotonic across the splice. map/power identities hold per-row throughout since neither segment's torque/rpm/boost_pressure/ambient_pressure was modified. fault_class is set to the first/dominant phase (lubrication_degradation); fault_sequence carries both phases in order.
